$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry: id (GHSA), package, reason, optional expires (YYYY-MM-DD, gate fails after it), optional importers (exemption applies only to paths rooted in these workspace packages). Prefer upgrading over adding entries. shippedRootEntries: root dependencies a release artifact ships (Electron, the pkg-built local proxy's requires); every advisory on a path from them is gated, transitive ones included unless the entry sets transitive: false (the package itself only).
